# Paper

> Paper provides 24/7 online tutoring and high-impact tutoring solutions for K-12 schools and districts, featuring live academic support, essay review, and curriculum-aligned small-group instruction.

Paper partners with school districts across the United States, including major implementations in California districts like LAUSD, Paramount USD, and Val Verde USD. The platform offers both on-demand tutoring and structured high-impact tutoring through their GROW product, with integrations for Canvas LMS and Google Workspace.

## Key Topics

- 24/7 tutoring
- High-impact tutoring
- GROW tutoring program
- Essay Review and writing feedback
- K-12 education support
- Student-centered learning
- Educational equity
- Distance learning solutions
- Academic support platform
- School district partnerships
- Canvas LMS integration
- Google Workspace integration
- Teacher resources
- Student independence and self-advocacy
- Curriculum-aligned instruction

## Core Products and Services

- [GROW | High-Impact Tutoring | Paper](https://paper.co/grow): GROW high-impact tutoring product: curriculum-aligned small-group instruction
- [Free 24/7 academic support for LAUSD](https://paper.co/lausd/parents-guardians): LAUSD parent/guardian portal for K-6 and K-8 SPAN tutoring and resources
- [Paper product spotlight: Canvas LMS and Google Workspace integrations](https://paper.co/blog/paper-product-spotlight-canvas-lms-and-google-workspace-integrations): New Paper integrations with Canvas LMS and Google Workspace announced
